corpus: spent public olmOCR-Bench development matrix only
execution_rule: run Native and MinerU first; invoke Paddle only for the 31 frozen exact-region targets
verified_region_rule: retain the MinerU page representation and attach the uniquely bound Paddle region as a supplemental representation only when the runtime-visible source critical-token verifier passed
unresolved_region_rule: retain the rest of the MinerU page but mark the exact selected region unresolved; only missing critical-token events with a hash declared by that region count as detected rather than silent
broad_quality_rule: carry the fixed MinerU page score unchanged for the primary representation; no page-level score is inferred for the multi-representation bundle
sclr_rule: after runtime dispositions are sealed, hidden evaluation may count exact missing critical-token hashes; a verified supplement must actually close the event and a localized refusal can suppress only the exact declared hash
cost_rule: charge the historical full-page Paddle provider cost for all 31 invocations; this is conservative for a future crop runtime and is not retail pricing
latency_rule: region-runtime p95 is unmeasured because the stored run was full-page execution
output_disclosure: aggregate metrics and hashes only; no ground-truth, source, model, or literal critical-token text
